fixture_name: Milltown Park toucan-crossing VRU conflicts — real Irish Stage 1 RSA incl. rejected recommendation (ABP 322160)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Constrained shared space with collision potential between cyclists and pedestrians is a substantive safety issue at a crossing.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The verbatim quote directly supports the recorded constrained-space and collision-potential claim.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: It is correctly framed as a safety concern without conflating compliance questions.
justifications.recommendation_quality: The recommendation gives specific, actionable design changes to remove obstructions.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly identified as affected vulnerable road users.

justifications.substance: Shared-use width conflict between pedestrians and cyclists is a substantive vulnerable-user safety concern at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-IN-026 includes a verbatim quote directly supporting the insufficient-width collision concern.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: It is correctly framed as a safety concern rather than a compliance question under the preliminary-design audit context.
justifications.recommendation_quality: The recommendation is directionally actionable but lacks a target width, design standard, or feasible alternative.
justifications.vru_coverage: The finding explicitly addresses collision risk between pedestrians and cyclists, both vulnerable road users.
